name: Microkernel (Plugin) Architecture
catalog_source: Richards & Ford (2020), Ch. 12; Buschmann et al. (POSA 1)
forces_resolved: Separation of core domain logic from variable customer/workflow features
forces_unresolved: Complex plugin contract versioning and governance
Core system changes risk breaking multiple external plugins
applicability_conditions: Applications with customizable product lines, IDEs, or rule engines
Workflows requiring frequent addition of third-party integrations or rules
Packaged software or desktop / single-tenant enterprise deployments
anti_requisites: Massive horizontal scaling across cloud regions (> 30,000 rps)
High frequency micro-redeployments of independent data stores
